intro:
To make my dream come true, I need to raise €32,000. I can't do that on my own. Would you like to do your bit? You can – whether you're a business or an individual. You can donate any amount via GoFundMe, or you can join the Club of 100. And of course you can also sponsor me as a business.

Everything donated to me goes entirely to School at Sea.
gofundmeSamenvatting: Every euro donated brings me a step closer to my goal, so I'm over the moon with every single one.
clubSamenvatting: I'm looking for 100 people who'd like to contribute at least €100. As a thank-you, you'll get a handmade serving board with the Thalassa on it!
clubTekst:
My dream is a big one, so I'm looking for a number of major sponsors. I'm looking for 100 people who'd like to contribute at least €100 to my project. I'd love to list your names on my website under the heading 'Club of 100'. Are you in?

Every member of the Club of 100 will receive a handmade serving board from me, with a drawing of the Thalassa – the ship we'll be making our voyage on.
zakelijkSamenvatting: Businesses can sponsor me too. Naturally, there's something in return – from a mention to your very own flag in the rigging!
zakelijkTekst:
Businesses can sponsor me too. I'd be happy to come by and tell you about my dream.

As well as being really grateful for every contribution that brings me closer to my dream, sponsorship of course comes with something in return.

tegenprestaties.tekst: A mention on my website and on the School at Sea website. In consultation with you, I'll write a piece about my project for your website or newsletter.
Your flag comes along (max. 1 × 1.5 metres) and is hoisted in the rigging when we leave and when we arrive back in the Netherlands.
Your flag is hoisted in every port!

factuurTekst: Businesses that would like to support me will receive a sponsorship invoice from School at Sea. This invoice includes 21% VAT. The amount is paid to School at Sea and is deducted by School at Sea from the amount I have to pay for the voyage. Should the voyage not go ahead for me for any reason, School at Sea will get in touch to discuss what should happen to the money.
contactTekst: Interested? Drop me a message and I'll happily come by!
